metadata.question: In the Norwegian Sea during Septermber 1, 2019, is the water color at (50.282684, -58.944881) more milky than (50.415337, -54.128047)?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Sentinel-2 MSI (10 m) with B1–B12, 2019-09-01 ±1 week (so 2019-08-25 → 2019-09-08) over two tiny Point geometries in the Norwegian Sea. Order: Sentinel-2 L2A → if empty, try Sentinel-2 L1C → if still empty, try Landsat-8/9 SR. 2. Masking: use the built-in QA60 cloud mask (bits 10 & 11) because “milky” can be caused by turbidity or phytoplankton, not clouds. 3. Milky proxy: suspended sediments / coccolithophores brighten blue-green bands; simple robust index is (B3 – B1)/(B3 + B1) (green–blue)/(green+blue). A more negative value ⇒ greener (clearer); a more positive value ⇒ milkier. Compute image-wise medians for each point, then median-of-medians to guard against outliers. Check collection sizes first (C1), then valid-pixel counts after masking (C2). If either result is None/NaN, emit C3; else compare the two numbers – choose “Yes” if the first point is milkier (larger index). ```python import ee, math ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time p1 = ee.Geometry.Point([-58.944881, 50.282684]) p2 = ee.Geometry.Point([-54.128047, 50.415337]) date_start = '2019-08-25' date_end = '2019-09-08' def get_col(aoi): col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(date_start, date_end) .filter(ee.Filter.lte('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30))) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: # fallback L1C col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(date_start, date_end) .filter(ee.Filter.lte('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30))) return col.map(lambda img: img.updateMask( img.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(0x0C00).eq(0))) col1 = get_col(p1) col2 = get_col(p2) s1, s2 = col1.size().getInfo(), col2.size().getInfo() print(f"Images p1: {s1}, p2: {s2}") if s1 == 0 or s2 == 0: print("C1") def milk_index(im, p): gr = im.select('B3'); bl = im.select('B1') idx = gr.subtract(bl).divide(gr.add(bl)).rename('milk') return idx.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.median(), geometry=p, scale=60, maxPixels=1e9).get('milk') idx1 = col1.map(lambda im: milk_index(im, p1)).getInfo() idx2 = col2.map(lambda im: milk_index(im, p2)).getInfo() vals1 = [v for v in idx1 if v is not None and not math.isnan(v)] vals2 = [v for v in idx2 if v is not None and not math.isnan(v)] if not vals1 or not vals2: print("C2") v1, v2 = float(ee.List(vals1).median().getInfo()), float(ee.List(vals2).median().getInfo()) print(f"p1 milk-index: {v1:.3f}, p2: {v2:.3f}") if v1 is None or v2 is None: print("C3") print("A" if v1 > v2 else "B") ```

import ee, math
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
p1 = ee.Geometry.Point([-58.944881, 50.282684])
p2 = ee.Geometry.Point([-54.128047, 50.415337])
date_start = '2019-08-25'
date_end   = '2019-09-08'

def get_col(aoi):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR')
             .filterBounds(aoi)
             .filterDate(date_start, date_end)
             .filter(ee.Filter.lte('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)))
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:                       # fallback L1C
        col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2')
                 .filterBounds(aoi)
                 .filterDate(date_start, date_end)
                 .filter(ee.Filter.lte('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)))
    return col.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(
                       img.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(0x0C00).eq(0)))

col1 = get_col(p1)
col2 = get_col(p2)
s1, s2 = col1.size().getInfo(), col2.size().getInfo()
print(f"Images p1: {s1}, p2: {s2}")
if s1 == 0 or s2 == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

def milk_index(im, p):
    gr = im.select('B3'); bl = im.select('B1')
    idx = gr.subtract(bl).divide(gr.add(bl)).rename('milk')
    return idx.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.median(), geometry=p, scale=60,
                            maxPixels=1e9).get('milk')

idx1 = col1.map(lambda im: milk_index(im, p1)).getInfo()
idx2 = col2.map(lambda im: milk_index(im, p2)).getInfo()
vals1 = [v for v in idx1 if v is not None and not math.isnan(v)]
vals2 = [v for v in idx2 if v is not None and not math.isnan(v)]
if not vals1 or not vals2:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
v1, v2 = float(ee.List(vals1).median().getInfo()), float(ee.List(vals2).median().getInfo())
print(f"p1 milk-index: {v1:.3f}, p2: {v2:.3f}")
if v1 is None or v2 is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
print("<answer>A</answer>" if v1 > v2 else "<answer>B</answer>")
